page_title: ANG 1-1 REN | Angers v Rennes 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
88' Substitution. Ludovic Blas will be replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
87' Marc Bollengier blows for a foul after Valentin Rongier (Rennes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
83' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Seko Fofana.
83' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Esteban Lepaul is replaced by Fabian Rieder (Rennes).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mikayil Faye (Rennes) is coming onto the pitch as Lilian Brassier cannot continue after picking up an injury.

83' A dangerous towering header by Mohamed Meite (Rennes) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
82' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) will deliver the corner kick.

82' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rennes.
79' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
77' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
76' A goal, which was scored by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers), was disallowed due to offside.
74' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
74' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' Lanroy Machine (Angers) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
72' The resulting corner from Quentin Merlin (Rennes) comes to nothing.

71' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Herve Koffi makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Lanroy Machine (Angers) coming on for Prosper Peter.
69' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jim Allevinah (Angers) replacing Sidiki Cherif.
69' Louis Mouton comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).

68' Golden opportunity! Louis Mouton (Angers) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
67' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Herve Koffi makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
66' Prosper Peter (Angers) is flagged for offside.

65' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
64' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) steps up to send the ball in.
64' Seko Fofana (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.

63' This was a piece of cake for Brice Samba. Sidiki Cherif (Angers) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
60' Here's the change. Mousa Tamari leaves the pitch and Mohamed Meite (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
60' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) serves up a nice cross, but Herve Koffi punches the ball away.
58' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Herve Koffi intercepts the ball.
54' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) makes a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.

51' 1 - 1 Yassine Belkhdim shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Prosper Peter (Angers) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 1:1.
50' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Brice Samba, who smothers the ball.
49' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Sidiki Cherif (Angers).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Marc Bollengier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Brice Samba to make a comfortable save.
45+3' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Herve Koffi comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Today's referee Marc Bollengier rightly decides to book Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) for his harsh tackle.
36' The Angers players are exchanging some short passes.
33' Angers couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Brice Samba (Rennes) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
32' A yellow card for a tackle by Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes). Marc Bollengier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' Flag goes up against Louis Mouton (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
26' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
25' Alexandre Dujeux appears to have said too much and referee Marc Bollengier comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
24' The main referee, Marc Bollengier, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) is given a yellow card for dissent.
24' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) makes a strong challenge and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Quentin Merlin, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
20' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
19' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

19' Herve Koffi pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner. Now Rennes have a corner.
19' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

16' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Herve Koffi was alert and the score remains the same.
13' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Rennes force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Poor challenge! Haris Belkebla (Angers) is penalised for tripping and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle.
9' Seko Fofana (Rennes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
7' Louis Mouton (Angers) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.

6' He should have scored! Prosper Peter (Angers) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Brice Samba makes an easy save.
3' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Wow, what an escape. Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Rennes have a corner.
2' What a chance that is! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Angers will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier will supervise the game today.
